from abc import ABC, abstractmethod


class IGeoIP(ABC):
    """Interface for GeoIP lookup functionality."""

    @abstractmethod
    def lookup(self, ip: str) -> str:
        """Return country name for given IP address."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    def lookup_emoji(self, ip: str) -> str:
        """Return country emoji flag for given IP address."""
        pass


class INodeNameGenerator(ABC):
    """Interface for node name generation."""

    @abstractmethod
    def next(self, country_emoji: str, country: str) -> str:
        """Generate next node name using country emoji and name."""
        pass
